senses.gloss: תִּיחֵם (denom. of תְּחוּם) to mark the limits of, form landmarks.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 56a:6">B. Bath. 56ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="H01507"><he>חֲצוּבָא</he> II</cite>. Pesik. ʿĂniya, p. 137ᵇ <he>בעולם הזה מְתַחֲמִים … מְתַחֲמִין וכ׳</he> in this world they form landmarks with stones or cistus shrubs, but in the latter days they shall form landmarks with precious stones &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 339">Yalk. Is. 339</cite>; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 87">Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXXVII</cite>.
